title: Learning Non-Gaussian SEMs with Conditional Risk, and Why the Direction of Recursion Matters
abstract: arXiv:2610.14246v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Variance-based methods recover a Gaussian linear structural equation model (SEM) with equal or suitably constrained error variances, either by recursively identifying the source nodes with smallest conditional variance (top-down method) or sink nodes with highest conditional variance (bottom-up method). We show that the use of conditional variance is incidental: replacing it with the conditional risk, i.e., the minimal expected loss of linear prediction under the negative log-likelihood of the noise distribution, extends both methods to non-Gaussian noise. Existing methods are the least-squares special case. This yields two main results. First, exploiting the noise distribution improves structure recovery: the matched-loss procedures recover the SEM more accurately than their least-squares counterparts and the LiNGAM methods, which are designed for non-Gaussianity. translated_title: 基于条件风险学习非高斯结构方程模型，以及递归方向为何至关重要
translated_abstract: 基于方差的方法能够恢复误差方差相等或受到适当约束的高斯线性结构方程模型（SEM），其方式是通过递归地识别具有最小条件方差的源节点（自顶向下方法），或者识别具有最大条件方差的汇节点（自底向上方法）。我们证明，条件方差的使用只是偶然的：将其替换为条件风险——即在噪声分布的负对数似然下线性预测的最小期望损失——可以将这两种方法扩展到非高斯噪声情形。现有方法只是该方法在最小二乘情形下的特例。这带来了两个主要结果。第一，利用噪声分布信息可以改进结构恢复：匹配损失的识别方法比其最小二乘对应方法以及专为非高斯性设计的LiNGAM方法能更准确地恢复SEM。第二，这两种方法在高斯情形下可以互换使用，但在非高斯情形下则会出现分化，递归方向的选择因此变得重要。
tldr: 本文提出用条件风险替代条件方差，将基于方差的结构方程模型识别方法从高斯情形扩展到非高斯噪声，证明匹配损失方法比最小二乘方法和LiNGAM更准确，且在高斯情形下可互换的自顶向下与自底向上递归方向在非高斯情形下会产生不同的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper replaces conditional variance with conditional risk to extend variance-based SEM identification methods from Gaussian to non-Gaussian noise, showing that matched-loss procedures outperform least-squares and LiNGAM methods, and that the top-down and bottom-up recursion directions, interchangeable in the Gaussian setting, lead to different outcomes in the non-Gaussian setting.
